name: g29_edge_cases
purpose: Edges of the item transfers: a Grimmsnarl with no item tricks a Raichu with none (-fail: both hands empty); an Arcanine-Hisui that holds Leftovers uses Thief at a Sneasler that holds a Sitrus Berry (nothing happens: the user holds an item); the Grimmsnarl then tricks the Sneasler (Unburden): the berry goes to the Grimmsnarl with the silent -enditem and the -item line, the Sneasler's Unburden volatile is set by the take and doubles its Speed from then on.
